snippet.title: Alien: Rogue Incursion | Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Survive the swarm. Destroy the corruption. Stay defiant to the end. 👊 

#AlienRogueIncursion is coming to PS VR2 and PCVR this Thursday, December 19, 2024! Pre-order today to get an exclusive weapon and armor skin inspired by Alien: Romulus. 🔗https://bit.ly/AlienRI

Alien: Rogue Incursion releases on Meta Quest 3 February 13, 2025.
